body.name: Stratified face/corner spectral experiment
body.construction: For each fixed \(\eta\), minimize \(\mathcal E_\eta(\psi)=\int_{\mathbb R}\{4|\psi'(u)|^2+V(u,\eta)|\psi(u)|^2\}\,du\) over \(\psi\in H^1(\mathbb R)\) with \(\int\psi^2=1\). The full value is the infimum over fibers \(\eta\in\mathbb R\); the transverse dual is allowed to be a probability measure, including a point mass at \(\eta=0\).
